$comment: Brand message for this brand. Fill in every empty string, then run `npm run build`. Rules referenced (P1, S3 ...) are explained in foundations/messaging/README.md.

positioning.$help: Perennial Seller (P1, P2). Write these before any campaign.

oneLiner.$help: StoryBrand one-liner (S9): problem -> solution -> result. Read together it should sound like one natural answer to 'what do you do?'

voice.$help: Ogilvy O11: one consistent personality. Three to five words each.

proof.$help: Ogilvy O5 and StoryBrand S4: specific facts, numbers, testimonials and clients to draw on.
